## Mathematical disposition

**30001654 / OWR-4791-010 remains UNRESOLVED, Approach 1/5.** This proof-only edition contains accepted partial mathematics. It does not prove or disprove the general asymptotic target ssat(n,C5)=11n/8+O(1).

For n>=5, if deleting original leaves leaves a core with universal vertex r, then 8e(G)>=11n-11-3epsilon, where epsilon records whether r supports a leaf. Equality is precisely the hub over disjoint P4 blocks, one leaf at each path vertex and optionally one at the hub. The complete proof includes all seven nonedge classes.

Under the broader hypothesis that every other vertex is reached from r by a simple path of exactly two edges, 8e(G)>=11(n-1)+w, where w counts nonleaf vertices outside N[r]. The full proof, base equality classification, no-leaf strengthening, one-root-leaf corollary and separate intersecting-neighborhood structural lemma are included.

For every t>=1, the extra-hub-leaf family has n=8t+2 and e=11t+1<ceil(11(n-1)/8)=11t+2. This refutes the optional eventual exact ceiling equality in the inspected arXiv:1103.0067v1. It does not refute the upper-bound inequality or the asymptotic conjecture, and no global extremality or exact finite semisaturation value is claimed.

## Attribution, audit and order scope

The original construction and leaf lemmas are credited to Zoltán Füredi and Younjin Kim, [Cycle-saturated graphs with minimum number of edges](https://arxiv.org/abs/1103.0067). The original target is also in [Combinatorics, Oberwolfach Report 01/2011](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/01). The complete mathematical audit, public PDF identities and recorded source/version/retrieval/inspection history are retained. Journal PDF retrieval failed; no journal-version defect claim is made.

The unrestricted rooted inequalities are unchanged. Their equality and root-leaf corollary now explicitly qualify the n>=5 classification and identify the unrestricted K1/K2 vacuous equality exceptions. This disclosed scope clarification follows the audit and does not introduce a hidden lower-order gap when deleting a leaf.

The general lower bound outside either rooted class remains missing. No reduction of arbitrary extremizers into those classes is established; the audit retains K3,3 as a concrete obstruction to simply discarding the hypotheses.

This work is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Acceptance does not mean external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. No first-discovery priority or exhaustive literature-status certification is claimed.

## Publication boundary

Exactly nine files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001654/`. The complete statements, mathematical proofs and audit are preserved, subject only to the explicit order qualification and scope-neutral editorial changes. The finite-verification section is removed wholesale, with no replacement prose. Computational-result references and private administrative/history material are omitted.

The edition contains no source bodies, extracts, images, datasets, scripts/checkers, standalone computational results/logs, private coordination files or identities of excluded artifacts. Eligible public scholarly PDF hashes, sizes and source metadata remain. There are no QUEUE.md changes, unrelated file edits or historical accounting resets. This is draft-only, with no merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach.

## Preparation checks

Both complete proofs and the entire final audit were read. Designated input identities, both original manifests and retained public PDF identities match. Exact editorial diffs and full mathematical-preservation checks are recorded locally. The manifest, exact allowlist, UTF-8/JSON, relative links and excluded-material scans pass. Strict-whitespace clean additive replay reproduces exactly the nine file paths and bytes. Complete base and expected ancestor Git trees were independently rehashed; all unrelated entries, including the QUEUE blob, are preserved. These are packaging checks, not a CI or formal proof-verification claim. Exact-head remote readback remains a separate publication check.
